answer_1.quote: To confirm the effectiveness of our proposed method on generation tasks, we conduct experiments on two types of generation tasks (i.e., math reasoning and symbolic reasoning) using GPT-4o-mini.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include predicted answers for reasoning tasks, such as solutions to math word problems and symbolic manipulation tasks.

answer_2.quote: The reward function r i = r(s i , a i ) measures the quality of the action a i applied to the state s i . Since ground-truth labels are not available at test time, we take the confidence of model prediction in f p as the reward, which has been shown to be aligned with the model performance.
